description: This file contains utility functions for managing enterprise key parameters related to team configurations, including setting key duration and organization ID on GenerateKeyRequest objects.

methods.name: GenerateKeyRequest add_team_member_key_duration( team_table: Optional[LiteLLM_TeamTable], data: GenerateKeyRequest, )
methods.description: Sets the 'duration' field of GenerateKeyRequest based on team table metadata, if available.

methods.name: GenerateKeyRequest add_team_organization_id( team_table: Optional[LiteLLM_TeamTable], data: GenerateKeyRequest, )
methods.description: Sets the 'organization_id' field of GenerateKeyRequest based on the team table's organization ID.

methods.name: GenerateKeyRequest apply_enterprise_key_management_params( data: GenerateKeyRequest, team_table: Optional[LiteLLM_TeamTable], )
methods.description: Applies key management parameters by invoking add_team_member_key_duration and add_team_organization_id.
